answer_1.quote: We generate LLM-generated Korean text using two commercial LLMs and two open-source LLMs... The KatFish includes text samples from argumentative essays, poetry, and research paper abstracts, produced by both humans and four LLMs.
answer_1.outputs: Korean essays, poems, and paper abstracts generated by LLMs

answer_3.quote: We use Exaone 3.5, an LLM released by the Korean company LG AI Research, to perform paraphrasing. We provide a Korean text to an LLM and ask it to output 1 if the text is LLM-generated and 0 if it is human-written.

answer_4.quote: We request qualitative analysis for expert evaluation from three native Korean speakers specializing in Korean literature or Korean language education... We design an evaluation rubric to assess text written by humans and generated by LLMs from multiple perspectives.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators use a rubric with criteria specific to each genre (essays: Language, Organization, Content; poetry: Poetic Diction, Organization, Content, Creativity; paper abstracts: Language, Organization, Content). Each item is rated on a 3-point scale.
